type.description: Kind of update; always ALERT_STATUS_CHANGED for this data

equipment_id.description: Identifier of the unit the alert concerns

alert_type.description: Kind of condition the alert reports

severity.description: How urgently the alert must be surfaced

previous_status.description: Status the alert left; null when the alert was just raised

peak_temperature.description: Most extreme temperature recorded for the alert, in Celsius; null when no temperature is involved

changed_at.description: Format: date-time (ISO 8601 UTC with Z, e.g. 2026-09-29T08:30:00Z) When the alert entered status
